import json,math
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("test-results/pr33824_expanded_all13_predictors_20260928_1933/models/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2/calibration/real")
total_requests=total_rows=0
for index in range(1,6):
    group=root/f"repeat-{index}"
    assert (group/"BASELINE_COLLECTION_COMPLETE").read_text().strip()=="complete"
    requests=rows=0
    files=sorted((group/"cases").glob("*/TP0.raw_request.jsonl"))
    assert len(files)==3
    for path in files:
        assert (path.parent/"status.txt").read_text().strip()=="ok"
        requests+=sum(bool(line.strip()) for line in path.read_text().splitlines())
        for line in (path.parent/"TP0.schedule_batch.jsonl").read_text().splitlines():
            if not line.strip():
                continue
            item=json.loads(line)
            if item["forward_mode"] in (1,2):
                latency=float(item["iter_latency"])
                assert item["request_infos"] and math.isfinite(latency) and 0<latency<=30
                rows+=1
    assert requests==160
    print("train group",index,"cases",len(files),"requests",requests,"timing rows",rows)
    total_requests+=requests
    total_rows+=rows
print("total",total_requests,"requests",total_rows,"timing rows")
assert total_requests==800 and total_rows==11319
